title: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.3 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to overwrite arbitrary files due to…
description: IBM Langflow OSS versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.3 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to overwrite arbitrary files. This occurs due to improper limitation of pathname to a restricted directory, enabling path traversal attacks. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
